title: When the Landfall Sings
author: Zephyrine Villalobos
blurb: Casper Galloway, a mountain guide blacklisted from two countries, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. But when a dying prospector trades a map for a promise, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
